gaussian_and_magnification.arithmetic: exact Fraction; both focal signs and real/virtual images
singularities: d_o=f: parallel rays, no finite image; not an unphysical optical system
d_i=f: object at infinity; d_i=-d_o: infinite f / zero power
zero conjugates/focal lengths excluded before simplification
m=0 with finite nonzero conjugates: no finite solution; m=d_i=0 is outside the profile

doppler.arithmetic: exact event intersections, not only frequency-formula replay
doppler.finding: r1 observer subsonic cap unnecessary; r2 includes approaching u_o=450>v=300 and u_o=-v zero-rate limit. Source remains subsonic.
singularities: u_o=-v: f_o=0, f_s and u_s individually underdetermined
f_o=f_s and u_o=-u_s: v undetermined; otherwise inconsistent
u_o inverse permits f_o=0 and uniquely gives -v

refracting_elements.arithmetic: exact Fraction; both radius/focal signs, index orderings, individually plane surfaces
singularities: Interface object focus: no finite d_i
Matched indices: radius not identifiable from d_i=-d_o
Lens index match or equal curvatures: zero power/infinite f
A single zero curvature is permitted, not a zero radius

simple_magnifier.source_review: Source's near-point image-distance sign slip not propagated; near point supplied as N rather than hard-coded 25 cm. General eye spacing does not obey the close-eye magnification bound.

limitations: Dimension checker uses mass,length,time,currency axes and treats pure zero as dimensionally polymorphic in inequalities.
Coherent research 1/m is checked locally; this does not extend the installed registry or make records runtime-ready.
Grid checks verify the documented inverse algebra and singularities, not source truth, optical approximation error, actual parameter measurements or physical instance compatibility.
Published rounded numerical evidence remains as reported in the data; these rational checks do not replace it with recomputed expected values.
